cards.card_text: Then he says the LORD discards all the wicked on earth like dross.
cards.verse_text: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
cards.snippet: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.

cards.card_text: The LORD discards the wicked like dross.
cards.verse_text: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
cards.snippet: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.

cards.card_text: Next, a silversmith: “Remove the dross from the silver, and a vessel for a silversmith will come forth.” Get the junk out and something useful shows up, and friend, I know a LITTLE something about getting pulled out of a junk drawer.
cards.verse_text: Remove the dross from the silver, and a vessel for a silversmith will come forth.
cards.snippet: Remove the dross from the silver, and a vessel for a silversmith will come forth.

cards.card_text: Then Isaiah says the city's silver has become dross.
cards.verse_text: Your silver has become dross; your fine wine is diluted with water.
cards.snippet: Your silver has become dross; your fine wine is diluted with water.

cards.card_text: Then the Lord says He will turn His hand against the city and thoroughly purge its dross.
cards.verse_text: I will turn My hand against you; I will thoroughly purge your dross; I will remove all your impurities.
cards.snippet: I will turn My hand against you; I will thoroughly purge your dross; I will remove all your impurities.

cards.card_text: God says the house of Israel has become dross to Him, all copper, tin, iron and lead inside the furnace.
cards.verse_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me.
cards.snippet: …to me, saying, “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me.

cards.card_text: Because the house of Israel has become dross, God says He'll gather them into one city.
cards.verse_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because all of you have become dross, behold, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: …is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because all of you have become dross, behold, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
